basic_info.description: Just 3 blocks from the proposed Entertainment Zone on 7th and Folsom! 1 block to Yerba Buena Gardens! Museums! Moscone Center! Bustling and growing neighborhood! Spacious and stylish, this fabulous one-bedroom residence in the heart of Yerba Buena offers over 800 sq. ft. plus a patio, making it one of the largest one-bedroom units in the building. Enjoy your own private outdoor patio off your spacious bedroom with walk in closet, plus a versatile den with built-in shelving, perfect for a home office or creative space. The open-concept layout features a contemporary kitchen and airy living area, framed by floor-to-ceiling windows that flood the space with natural light. The sleek modern bathroom blends form and function, while a large entry closet includes a stackable washer/dryer and extra storage. Residents enjoy access to a stunning rooftop deck with sweeping city views, 24/7 door service, and secure bike storage. Built in 2010, 829 Folsom is a 69-unit boutique building located just steps from SF MOMA, Yerba Buena Gardens, top dining, shops, and entertainment. Easy neighborhood parking with many monthly garage options. Great Roof deck! Conference room!
